# Pure C++ TurboModule library, added to the app's appmodules build by React Native's autolinking
# (react-native.config.js cxxModuleCMakeListsPath). The codegen target react_codegen_RnrsCmpCxxSpec
# is generated by the app build (pure C++ dependency codegen).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
project(rnrscmpcxx)
add_library(rnrscmpcxx STATIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../cpp/RnrsCmpCxx.cpp)
target_include_directories(rnrscmpcxx PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../cpp)
target_link_libraries(rnrscmpcxx react_codegen_RnrsCmpCxxSpec fbjni jsi reactnative)
target_compile_reactnative_options(rnrscmpcxx PRIVATE)
